# IT Security Audit Findings: Encryption & Firewall Standards

**Ref ID:** ITD-BATCH-071
**Date:** 2026-04-14

This report details necessary actions following an audit concerning IT security standards:

*   Investigate current encryption standards.
*   Update encryption standards based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor firewall settings for compliance and security.
*   Monitor encryption standards for ongoing compliance and effectiveness.
